name: Natsugoe Chiho
source:
The Beloved Mascot-like Classmate

A classmate in Arata's new school. 
Having a warm and welcoming demeanor, Chiho and Arata quickly become friends. With her warm and friendly personality, she easily wins the hearts of those around her, becoming the class's beloved mascot. 
Chiho's positive outlook on life allows her to find joy in every situation, and her genuine emotions and sensitivity make her easily moved by the things she notices.

"Look! Look! The sunset is so pretty!"

Point: Basking in the affection of a friendly girl
Going home style: In a group. Chiho typically walks home with two friends, forming a lively trio, and their route is unpredictable.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/houkago2/character-2.html]Official website[/url]]
